items.title: Redraws and Faces
items.why:
Your round-three picks are set: full color, Kame House, rice bowl, Dragon Ball, soccer ball, heart, ki blast, stopwatch, gold scale, clock, gear, calendar, drop, and the 悟 gi symbol for You.

This page has the four icons you asked me to redo, plus a much more careful pass at the character faces and the setup coach. Shenron, the Super Saiyan auras, the over-9,000 moment, the Dragon Balls and Senzu beans, and the Turtle School theme come in the next page.

items.title: Turtle Shell, Redrawn
items.why: Your note: it was too round to read as a shell. Now it's seen from the side: a domed shell with hexagon plates and the pale rim underneath.

items.title: Meat on the Bone, Redrawn
items.why: Your note: it looked like a wrapped candy. Now it's a big roasted chunk with grill marks and one bone sticking out with knuckle ends.

items.title: Senzu Beans, Redrawn
items.why: Your note: it looked like a mystery kidney bean. Two ideas: three shiny Senzu beans together, or Korin's cloth pouch with a bean on top.

items.title: Character Faces, Careful Pass
items.why:
Your note: the first faces looked lame and cheap. These are redrawn at twice the detail with cel shading: Goku's real hairline with his bangs, Vegeta's widow's peak and armor, Piccolo's ears, antennae and turban, Roshi's shades and beard. Each is shown large and at the size it appears in the app.

Honest note: these are still drawn by hand in code, so they're clean but simple. If you like where they're going, I'll do all 18 fighters to this standard. You picked the 悟 symbol for the You icon, which stays either way.
